messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT: multiple 5xxs reported for /v1/generate from us-west-2 -- alert fired at 2026-03-14T02:45Z. Pager sent to eng-oncall primary. See runbook: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/5xx-high-rate

maria: taking this as primary for the next 30m. Quick summary: error rate ~6% over 10m, latency up ~200ms. Customer impact: some hosted API customers seeing truncated responses and retries. Not yet SLA-breach but trending.

aj: pinging infra team to check infra autoscaler / node pressure. @infra-oncall can you confirm if any GPU nodes reported OOM or node restarts?

infra-oncall: we saw a single node OOM in us-west-2-gpu-pool-3 at 02:36Z and it recovered via restart. No full pod evictions but observer noted higher CPU on the router instances. Sharing logs: https://logs.redwood/p/abcd1234

sandeep: runtime side: we've got increased KV-cache misses for the recent 8k-context model rollout, causing more model loads. We're seeing cold-starts. If infra autoscaler delays model preloading that amplifies errors.

maria: ok so this is likely cross-team: infra node pressure -> runtime model cold starts -> client retries cause cascading errors. Need to decide mitigation chain: 1) stop the rollout, 2) bump preload concurrency, 3) add temporary route to smaller-context model. Thoughts?

leah: +1 to pause the rollout. We can flip rollout flag in console (rollout id r-20260314-08). I'll be on the console for the next 15m to handle.

jess (support): heads-up that two paying customers (acme-corp, medapps) have opened tickets about truncated responses. I've put them on priority and linked status page. Need ETA for mitigation so I can update them.

runtime-oncall: we can enable aggressive prewarming for the affected model group. Patch to set `preload_concurrency: 4` on pool 3 should land fast. Also we can hot-route traffic to the legacy 4k model (model:v4k-stable) with a rollback rule.

sec-oncall: no security signal here, but FYI we've got elevated alert noise from the deploy bot that may cause alert fatigue. If you need to escalate, ping me.

maria: plan of action (short): 1) @leah pause rollout (in 2 min) 2) @runtime-oncall apply preload_concurrency bump 3) @infra-oncall watch node metrics & temporarily scale router pool + add swap headroom 4) @jess notify customers with proposed ETA ~15-30m. If errors drop to <1% we consider incident mitigated and hand off.

leah: paused rollout (r-20260314-08) at 02:50Z. Confirmed in console.

infra-oncall: scaling router pool + increased node headroom. Also added temp flag to avoid draining during high error window. Watching.

runtime-oncall: applied preload_concurrency patch at 02:53Z. Patch id: pr-4892. Logs show model load time dropped ~60% for subsequent requests.

maria: monitoring --- errors down to 1.3% over last 5m, latency normalizing. Good. If we stay under 1.5% for 10m we'll call this mitigated.

sandeep: adding a follow-up action: run a targeted regression to measure KV-cache miss rate versus preload concurrency. Ticket: #INC-2026-0314.

jess (support): updated customers: told them we paused rollout and applied mitigations, ETA 15-30m, support rep on call if they escalate. They appreciated the proactive update.

maria: quick note about coverage: primary shift ends in 18m. I will hand to @aj as primary if things remain stable. Also flagging coverage gap tomorrow 03:00-06:00 UTC where we only have one on-call engineer for infra+runtime due to PTO. Need to confirm backup so we don't have routing ambiguity.

aj: I can take primary once you sign off. For the coverage gap, I'll reach out to ops and see if we can get a backup from platform team or swap shifts. If not, we should update the incident routing rule to send runtime pages to infra as secondary.

maria: handoff checklist (for whoever takes primary): - confirm incident severity and impact, - confirm mitigations in place and PRs/patch ids, - update customers + status page, - ensure runbook link is pinned in thread, - note any outstanding follow-ups (e.g., #INC-2026-0314).

leah: FYI runbook pointer for this flow: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/runtime-coldstart. Also routing matrix for pages: https://intra.redwood/oncall/routing-matrix (runtime -> runtime-oncall primary, infra -> infra-oncall, security flags -> sec-oncall). Make sure routing table matches current paging config.

infra-oncall: during high-load windows, router autoscaler sometimes lags 30-60s behind bursts. Short-term mitigation: pre-scale router by 20% for the next 2 hours. I'll schedule that now.

sec-oncall: if you change routing rules, remember to add me in the escalation chain for any irreversible routing changes.

maria: errors holding ~1.1% over 10m, looks stable. I'm going to hand to @aj now. @aj please ack and monitor next 40m. If anything spikes >3% or latency >1s, page the on-call group immediately.

aj: taking primary at 03:12Z. Acked. I have dashboard links: https://dash.redwood/incident/INC-2026-0314 and the logs link. I'll post a short summary to #status when we hit mitigation.

sandeep: follow-up items I'll own: 1) deeper postmortem on KV-cache miss pattern, 2) propose model rollout gating (canary length + preload threshold), 3) identify telemetry gaps that hid the issue.

jess (support): creating a post-contact note for acme-corp and medapps, will include timeline and mitigation steps.

maria: thanks all. Leaving the thread open for any late regressions. If anyone wants the full handoff notes, I'll paste them in the handoff doc: https://intra.redwood/handoffs/2360007890-handoff (owner: maria).

oncall-bot: NOTE: handoff recorded at 03:12Z from maria -> aj. Handoff token: HND-2360007890

aj: confirmed. Closing primary shift notes and monitoring. If nothing else, I'll file the incident notification and add follow-ups to the ops board.

leah: follow-up: we've scheduled a postmortem sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. Invites sent to runtime, infra, product (release owners), and support.

maria: thread closed from my side unless we see a regression. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
